ei.title: Chapter 4-12 2번: Market Power vs. Resource Depletion
ei.subject: 올림포스독해의기본1

fullPassage: Forecasters who predict resource depletion often ignore or underestimate the power of markets. For example, some forecasters use a current reserve index to estimate how long a resource would last. The current reserve index divides the current known reserve of a resource by the amount currently used each period. So, if we know of 445 billion barrels of oil, and we are currently using 15 billion barrels per year, the index indicates that we will run out of oil in about 30 years. Some studies, like the Limits to Growth, further assume that demand will increase each year, thus depleting resources even faster. But what they fail to see is that if markets are allowed to do their usual duty, that is, prices rise as depletion occurs, resources will last much longer.

questions.passage: Forecasters who ①<u>predict</u> resource depletion often ignore or underestimate the power of markets. For example, some forecasters use a current reserve index to estimate how long a resource would ②<u>last</u>. The current reserve index ③<u>dividing</u> the current known reserve of a resource by the amount ④<u>currently</u> used each period. So, if we know of 445 billion barrels of oil, and we are currently using 15 billion barrels per year, the index indicates that we will run out of oil in about 30 years. Some studies, like the Limits to Growth, further assume that demand will increase each year, thus depleting resources even faster. But what they fail to see is that if markets are allowed to do their usual duty, that is, prices rise as depletion occurs, resources will last much longer.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 주어 The current reserve index에 대한 주절 동사가 필요하므로 divides(3인칭 단수 현재)가 올바르다. dividing(분사)은 주절 동사 역할 불가.
det.analysis:
① predict — 주어 Forecasters(복수) + predict 수일치 정상
② last — how long a resource would last(얼마나 지속될지) 동사원형 정상
③ dividing — 원문 divides, 주어 The current reserve index의 주절 동사 필요 ←정답
④ currently — 부사, the amount currently used 정상
det.tip: 주절에는 정형동사(divides)가 필요. 분사(dividing)는 주절 동사 역할 불가.

questions.passage: Forecasters who predict resource depletion often ①<u>ignore</u> or underestimate the power of markets. For example, some forecasters use a current reserve index to estimate how long a resource would last. The current reserve index divides the current ②<u>knowing</u> reserve of a resource by the amount currently used each period. So, if we know of 445 billion barrels of oil, and we are currently ③<u>using</u> 15 billion barrels per year, the index indicates that we will run out of oil in about 30 years. Some studies, like the Limits to Growth, further assume that demand will increase each year, thus depleting resources even faster. But what they fail to see is that if markets are allowed to do their usual duty, that is, prices rise as depletion occurs, resources will last much ④<u>longer</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: reserve를 수식하는 과거분사 known(알려진)이 올바르다. knowing(현재분사: 알고 있는)은 reserve의 의미와 맞지 않는다.
det.analysis:
① ignore — 동사원형, Forecasters ... often ignore 정상
② knowing — 원문 known, the current known reserve(현재 알려진 매장량) 수동의미 ←정답
③ using — 현재분사, we are currently using 진행형 정상
④ longer — 비교급 부사, last much longer 정상
det.tip: known(과거분사: 알려진) — 수동 의미. knowing(현재분사: 알고 있는) — 능동 의미.

questions.passage: Forecasters ①<u>who</u> predict resource depletion often ignore or underestimate the power of markets. For example, some forecasters use a current reserve index to estimate how long a resource would last. The current reserve index divides the current known reserve of a resource by the amount currently ②<u>used</u> each period. So, if we know of 445 billion barrels of oil, and we are currently using 15 billion barrels per year, the index indicates that we will run out of oil in about 30 years. Some studies, like the Limits to Growth, further assume that demand will increase each year, thus ③<u>depleting</u> resources even faster. But what they fail to see ④<u>are</u> that if markets are allowed to do their usual duty, that is, prices rise as depletion occurs, resources will last much longer.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: what절 주어(what they fail to see)는 단수 취급이므로 is가 올바르다. are는 수일치 오류.
det.analysis:
① who — 관계대명사 주격, Forecasters who predict 정상
② used — 과거분사, the amount currently used each period 정상
③ depleting — 분사구문, thus depleting resources(그래서 자원을 고갈시키며) 정상
④ are — 원문 is, what they fail to see is that~(what절 주어 단수) ←정답
det.tip: what절이 주어일 때 단수 취급: What S + V + is that ~

questions.passage: Forecasters who predict resource depletion often ignore or underestimate the power of markets. For example, some forecasters use a current reserve index to ①<u>estimate</u> how long a resource would last. The current reserve index ②<u>combines</u> the current known reserve of a resource by the amount currently used each period. So, if we know of 445 billion barrels of oil, and we are currently using 15 billion barrels per year, the index indicates that we will run out of oil in about 30 years. Some studies, like the Limits to Growth, further assume that demand will ③<u>increase</u> each year, thus depleting resources even faster. But what they fail to see is that if markets are allowed to do their usual duty, that is, prices ④<u>rise</u> as depletion occurs, resources will last much longer.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: '결합하다(combines)'가 아니라 '나누다(divides)'가 문맥상 적절하다. 매장량 지수는 알려진 매장량을 사용량으로 나눈다.
det.analysis:
① estimate — 추정하다, 원문 일치
② combines — 원문 divides(나누다), 매장량을 사용량으로 나누어 산출 ←정답
③ increase — 증가하다, demand will increase 원문 일치
④ rise — 오르다, prices rise 원문 일치
det.tip: divides(나누다) ↔ combines(결합하다). 지수 = 매장량 ÷ 사용량.

questions.passage: Forecasters who predict resource ①<u>depletion</u> often ignore or underestimate the power of markets. For example, some forecasters use a current reserve index to estimate how long a resource would last. The current reserve index divides the current known reserve of a resource by the amount currently used each period. So, if we know of 445 billion ②<u>barrels</u> of oil, and we are currently using 15 billion barrels per year, the index indicates that we will run out of oil in about 30 years. Some studies, like the Limits to Growth, further ③<u>assume</u> that demand will increase each year, thus depleting resources even faster. But what they fail to see is that if markets are ④<u>compelled</u> to do their usual duty, that is, prices rise as depletion occurs, resources will last much longer.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: '강요되다(compelled)'가 아니라 '허용되다(allowed)'가 문맥상 적절하다. 시장이 자유롭게 기능하도록 '허용'되면이라는 맥락이다.
det.analysis:
① depletion — 고갈, 원문 일치
② barrels — 배럴, 445 billion barrels 원문 일치
③ assume — 가정하다, 원문 일치
④ compelled — 원문 allowed(허용되다), 시장이 역할 수행하도록 허용 ←정답
det.tip: allowed(허용되다) ↔ compelled(강요되다). 시장의 자율적 기능을 강조하는 맥락.

questions.passage: Forecasters who predict resource depletion often ignore or underestimate the power of markets. For example, some forecasters use a current reserve index to estimate how long a resource would last. The current reserve index divides the current known reserve of a resource by the amount currently used each period. So, if we know of 445 billion barrels of oil, and we are currently using 15 billion barrels per year, the index indicates that we will __________ oil in about 30 years. Some studies, like the Limits to Growth, further assume that demand will increase each year, thus depleting resources even faster. But what they fail to see is that if markets are allowed to do their usual duty, that is, prices rise as depletion occurs, resources will last much longer.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 약 30년 후에 석유가 '고갈될(run out of)' 것이라는 맥락이다. 매장량 지수가 고갈 시점을 보여준다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① take advantage of — ~을 이용하다 (고갈 맥락 부적합)

❌ ② make use of — ~을 사용하다 (고갈이 아닌 활용)

❌ ③ keep track of — ~을 추적하다 (고갈 맥락 부적합)

✅ ④ run out of — ~이 바닥나다 (석유가 약 30년 후 고갈) ←정답
det.tip: run out of = ~이 바닥나다, 고갈되다. 매장량 지수의 결론: 30년 후 석유 고갈.

questions.passage: Forecasters who predict resource depletion often __________ the power of markets. For example, some forecasters use a current reserve index to estimate how long a resource would last. The current reserve index divides the current known reserve of a resource by the amount currently used each period. So, if we know of 445 billion barrels of oil, and we are currently using 15 billion barrels per year, the index indicates that we will run out of oil in about 30 years. Some studies, like the Limits to Growth, further assume that demand will increase each year, thus depleting resources even faster. But what they fail to see is that if markets are allowed to do their usual duty, that is, prices rise as depletion occurs, resources will last much longer.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 자원 고갈을 예측하는 전문가들이 시장의 힘을 '무시하거나 과소평가한다(ignore or underestimate)'는 것이 글의 첫 문장 핵심 주장이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① ignore or underestimate — 무시하거나 과소평가하다 ←정답

❌ ② harness and utilize — 활용하다 (글의 비판 방향과 반대)

❌ ③ regulate and control — 규제하고 통제하다 (시장 자율 맥락과 반대)

❌ ④ analyze and predict — 분석하고 예측하다 (전문가가 분석은 하되 시장의 힘을 간과)
det.tip: 전문가들이 시장 기능을 간과한다는 비판이 글 전체의 논지.

questions.passage: Forecasters who predict resource depletion often ignore or underestimate the power of markets. For example, some forecasters use a current reserve index to estimate how long a resource would last. The current reserve index divides the current known reserve of a resource by the amount currently used each period. So, if we know of 445 billion barrels of oil, and we are currently using 15 billion barrels per year, the index indicates that we will run out of oil in about 30 years. Some studies, like the Limits to Growth, further assume that demand will increase each year, thus depleting resources even faster. But what they fail to see is that if markets are allowed to do their usual duty, that is, prices rise as depletion occurs, resources will last much longer.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: 본문: 'we are currently using 15 billion barrels per year' — 15 billion = 150억 배럴. 정확히 일치.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 곱하여 → 원문은 divides(나누어). multiply가 아님

❌ ② 수요 감소 → 원문은 increase(증가)

✅ ③ 150억 배럴 — 15 billion barrels per year 일치 ←정답

❌ ④ 더 빨리 고갈 → 원문은 last much longer(훨씬 더 오래 지속)
det.tip: 15 billion = 150억. barrels per year = 연간 배럴.

ch: 현재 매장량 지수는 매장량에 사용량을 곱하여 산출한다.
일부 연구는 매년 수요가 감소할 것이라고 가정한다.
현재 매년 약 150억 배럴의 석유가 사용되고 있다.
시장 기능이 작동하면 자원은 더 빨리 고갈된다.

questions.passage: Forecasters who predict resource depletion often ignore or underestimate the power of markets. For example, some forecasters use a current reserve index to estimate how long a resource would last. The current reserve index divides the current known reserve of a resource by the amount currently used each period. So, if we know of 445 billion barrels of oil, and we are currently using 15 billion barrels per year, the index indicates that we will run out of oil in about 30 years. Some studies, like the Limits to Growth, further assume that demand will increase each year, thus depleting resources even faster. But what they fail to see is that if markets are allowed to do their usual duty, that is, prices rise as depletion occurs, resources will last much longer.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: 본문: 'resources will last much longer' — 시장 기능 작동 시 자원이 훨씬 더 오래 지속된다. '변하지 않는다'는 본문과 반대.
det.analysis:
✅ ① 과소평가 — underestimate 일치

✅ ② 약 30년 — about 30 years 일치

✅ ③ 수요 매년 증가 가정 — assume that demand will increase 일치

❌ ④ 자원 수명 변하지 않는다 → 원문은 last much longer(훨씬 더 오래 지속) ←정답
det.tip: 시장 가격 기능 → 가격 상승 → 소비 억제 → 자원 수명 '연장'.

ch: 자원 고갈 예측가들은 시장의 힘을 과소평가하는 경향이 있다.
매장량 지수에 따르면 석유는 약 30년 뒤 바닥날 수 있다.
'성장의 한계' 같은 연구는 수요가 매년 증가할 것이라 가정한다.
시장의 가격 조절 기능이 작동해도 자원 수명은 변하지 않는다.

questions.passage: Forecasters who predict resource depletion often ignore or underestimate the power of markets. For example, some forecasters use a current reserve index to estimate how long a resource would last. The current reserve index divides the current known reserve of a resource by the amount currently used each period. So, if we know of 445 billion barrels of oil, and we are currently using 15 billion barrels per year, the index indicates that we will run out of oil in about 30 years. Some studies, like the Limits to Growth, further assume that demand will increase each year, thus depleting resources even faster. But what they fail to see is that if markets are allowed to do their usual duty, that is, prices rise as depletion occurs, resources will last much longer.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: 본문의 핵심 주장: 예측가들이 시장의 힘을 무시/과소평가한다(ignore or underestimate the power of markets).
det.analysis:
❌ ① 가격 하락 → 원문 prices rise(가격 상승)

❌ ② 150억 배럴 → 150억은 연간 사용량. 매장량은 445 billion(4,450억 배럴)

✅ ③ 시장 역할 간과 비판 — 글 전체 논지 정확 ←정답

❌ ④ 수요 증가 반영 → 매장량 지수는 현재 사용량만 반영. 수요 증가 가정은 별도 연구(Limits to Growth)
det.tip: 매장량 지수 = 현재 매장량 ÷ 현재 사용량. 미래 수요 변화 미반영.

ch: 시장 기능이 작동하면 고갈 발생 시 가격이 하락한다.
저자는 자원 고갈 예측가들이 시장의 역할을 간과한다고 비판한다.
매장량 지수는 미래 수요 증가를 반영하여 산출된다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 시장의 가격 메커니즘이 자원 가용성을 연장하는 역할을 한다는 것이 글의 핵심 주제이다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① the necessity of government intervention in resource markets — 정부 개입 필요성 (본문은 시장 자율 기능 강조, 정부 규제 미언급)

✅ ② the role of market mechanisms in extending resource availability — 시장 메커니즘이 자원 가용성을 연장하는 역할 ←정답

❌ ③ methods to accurately calculate global oil reserves — 석유 매장량 정확한 계산법 (매장량 지수는 예시일 뿐, 글의 주제 아님)

❌ ④ the impact of population growth on natural resource depletion — 인구 증가가 자원 고갈에 미치는 영향 (인구 증가 언급 없음)
det.tip: 핵심 논지: 시장 가격 기능이 작동하면 자원이 훨씬 더 오래 지속된다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 제목으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 시장의 가격 메커니즘을 간과하는 예측가들 vs 시장의 자율 기능 — 누가 자원을 더 잘 이해하는가.
det.analysis:
❌ ① Why Oil Will Run Out Sooner Than Expected — 석유가 예상보다 빨리 고갈되는 이유 (글의 주장과 반대 — 시장 기능으로 더 오래감)

✅ ③ Markets vs. Forecasters: Who Understands Resources Better? — 시장 vs 예측가: 누가 자원을 더 잘 이해하는가 ←정답

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 do their usual duty가 이 글에서 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 시장의 '평소 의무'란 that is 뒤에 나오는 '고갈 발생 시 가격이 오르는 것', 즉 희소성에 대한 자연스러운 가격 조절 기능을 의미한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① adjust prices naturally in response to scarcity — 희소성에 대응하여 자연스럽게 가격 조절 ←정답

questions.passage: Forecasters who predict resource depletion often ignore or underestimate the power of markets. For example, some forecasters use a current reserve index to estimate how long a resource would last. The current reserve index divides the current known reserve of a resource by the amount currently used each period. So, if we know of 445 billion barrels of oil, and we are currently using 15 billion barrels per year, the index indicates that we will run out of oil in about 30 years. Some studies, like the Limits to Growth, further assume that demand will increase each year, thus depleting resources even faster. But what <u>they</u> fail to see is that if markets are allowed to do their usual duty, that is, prices rise as depletion occurs, resources will last much longer.
